title: Motor fuel-dispensing facilities.
officialText: Motor fuel-dispensing facilities, accessory to open parking lots, shall comply with the requirements of Section 406.5 of this code and the New York City Fire Code and Section 406.5 of this code. Motor fuel pumps shall be located at least 30 feet (9144 mm) from any parking space or interior lot line.
